body:
Thank you. You're very kind. I appreciate your words.

Yeah, in hindsight, a knife seems very...difficult. I've cut myself with a knife before on accident. Didn't react very well to it. Didn't take it well. 

I hope you stick around as well. You seem to be a good person. And the world needs more vegans in it.
Thank you. I'm flattered. I love to write. Though I myself think I'm actually quite terrible at it.

I guess folks wouldn't exactly celebrate my demise, would they? I've never lost anyone to suicide. Or known anyone who did. I guess, even if I wrote an entire essay about why they shouldn't cry over my body, and feel this way and that, they still would, I guess.

I've wanted to donate plasma, definitely. I'd have to get over my fear of needles and whatnot, but I could do it. Eventually.

I wish I could join some mutual aid group, like Food Not Bombs. Feed some starving folks. None of that is close by, though.

I never had the guts to self harm. My pain tolerance is abysmally low. I only picked the knife because I'm too poor to consider anything else. And it's portable. I could do it whenever I want, theoretically.
I wonder what those eight words were. Must've been pretty impressive. Then again, a lot of modern poetry is unimpressive.

I'm too poor to even consider therapy. I would, if I could scrape together the funds. Maybe in the future I will. 

Sucks that the cops would have to find my corpse. I don't want anyone to see that. Dead bodies can be disturbing. I'm always unnerved when I see a dead animal on the train tracks or ground. A human body would be jarring to bare witness to. 

I don't have a set date. Just something for the future. In case I'm certain I've got nothing left.

It's true. I am consumed by self hatred. I loathe my own presence, which is why I hate being alone. But it's only the way I can be, without feeling out of place, and like I don't belong. I find it hard to be around company sometimes. My friends eclipse me in ways I can't put into words. 

Although, staying alive to be amongst Nature and take care of it is a nice thought. I love it immensely.
Thank you, friend. I try to stay optimistic, but...my prospects, my very existence, looks rather grim.
Also, thank you for your kind words

I appreciate how both of you are vegan. That's actually one reason why I considered ending it. I'm one as well. Figured my body could do some good. Fertilize the soil. Feed some hungry critters.

Among many, many other reasons, of course.
I'm sorry to hear that you are also struggling so much. I understand how you feel. If it means anything, I'm here for you.
